messages:
anya (ML Eng): quick heads-up — kicked off Spectrum-11B bringup. did a quant sweep (fp16, int8, int6) across a small GTN slice + product traffic. need quick econ + routing recs.

matt g (infra): post the numbers pls

anya (ML Eng): pasted results from the 15k-prompt slice and a short/long product split simulation: 

```
Model                 | cfg   | p95 latency (ms, 512ctx) | throughput (tokens/s/GPU) | rel GTN acc (%) | cost per 1M tokens ($)
Spectrum-11B fp16     | fp16  | 480                      | 320k                      | 100.0           | 0.62
Spectrum-11B int8     | int8  | 520                      | 410k                      | 99.1            | 0.47
Spectrum-11B int6     | int6  | 560                      | 520k                      | 97.3            | 0.35
```

Notes: GTN acc is end-to-end QA/indicator accuracy on our GTN subset. p95 measured on 512-context chat sims. Cost is blended infra estimate (spot + batching overhead).

rachel (GTN): saw ~2.7pp drop on longform summarization with int6 — can you share a failing example?

anya (ML Eng): example (abbreviated):
- prompt: "Summarize this 2.5k token policy doc with key actions and risks."
- fp16 output: concise list of 6 actionable items with correct risks.
- int6 output: 4 items, missed the regulatory compliance risk and muddled two action steps.

sam (prod): product SLO is 300ms p95 for chat. int6 p95=560ms at 512ctx, so int6 alone won't meet chat SLO unless we special-case.

matt g (infra): routing proposal: short context (<512 tokens) -> int6, medium (512-2048) -> int8, long (>2048) -> fp16/dedicated. That keeps chat latency reasonable and sends heavy reasoning to higher-fidelity configs.

anya (ML Eng): ran a mixed-workload sim (70% short chat, 30% long). Projected blended cost per 1M tokens with the routing above = $0.39. Baseline fp16-only = $0.62 per 1M. Projected overall GTN acc drop = 0.6pp (weighted).

Scorecard / ops checklist (quick):
```
- Default routing: short (<512) -> int6 (saves ~44% vs fp16)
- Medium (512-2048) -> int8
- Long (>2048) -> fp16
- Canary: 10% traffic for 48h, monitor slices: summaries, math, instruction-following, hallucination spikes
- Alert thresholds: GTN slice regression >1.0pp OR hallucination rate increase >1.5x -> rollback affected route to int8
- KPIs to track: p95 latency per-route, GTN acc per-slice, token unit cost, user-visible failure rate
```

rachel (GTN): +1 on rollout plan. We need per-slice real-time eval hooks for omission/hallucination — will add to the dashboard.

ops-bot: deploy-candidate spectrum-11b-int6-cfg queued by anya — build #422 (status: queued)

matt g (infra): infra notes: KV-cache tuning for int6 is important — int6 cache pressure increases p95 tail. Recommend aggressive prefix-KV caching and decreasing per-request max-batch-wait from 20ms -> 10ms for chat routes.

sam (prod): pricing rec: recommend published hosted SKU at $0.40 per 1M tokens for the mixed-routing default; dedicated commitments to be negotiated (expect ~20-30% off depending on commit).

anya (ML Eng): final action items: open canary PR with routing flags, add GTN slices + hallucination hooks to dashboard, start 10% canary, collect 48h metrics, if regression >1pp then rollback. ping @rachel @matt g @sam for signoff. :rocket:
